_source: Five Parsecs: Tactics p.153 (Human Colonists profiles and Special Rules). Units are composed from data/tactics/army_builder.json (pp.133-139); weapons come from data/tactics/tactics_weapons_master.json (p.181)

species.description: The most widespread species in Unified Space. Human forces are well-organized and widely skilled, compensating for average individual ability with superior coordination and communication.

traits.name: Widely Skilled
traits.description: Humans are renowned for their communication skills. When making any roll to communicate, such as persuasion or negotiation (but NOT calling in Support), add +1 to the roll.

traits.name: Well Organized
traits.description: If a force is at least 50% human (including subtypes) you may select one Support option and lower the arrival score by 1.
